name: AIOStreams
description: AIOStreams consolidates multiple Stremio addons and debrid services into a single, highly customisable super-addon, with filtering, sorting, and formatting of results.

notes.text: No authentication is enabled by default. Set AIOSTREAMS_AUTH in /opt/aiostreams_data/.env to secure the dashboard.
SECRET_KEY is generated automatically and cannot be changed after first run without invalidating existing encrypted configs. Back up /opt/aiostreams_data/.env.

Uses SQLite by default (stored under /opt/aiostreams_data, along with every other on-disk cache the addon keeps - all derived from DATABASE_URI's directory). Edit DATABASE_URI in /opt/aiostreams_data/.env to use PostgreSQL instead.
Most configuration (addons, presets, formatting, proxying) is done from the dashboard Settings page after deployment, not via the .env file.

The optional "mount the library as a local folder" share (Shares > FUSE) needs /dev/fuse, which this container doesn't have by default. It's not required for normal use - the WebDAV and NFS shares work without it - but if you want it, set var_fuse=yes (or answer yes to "Enable FUSE support?" in the advanced install) before creating the container; this stays a safe, unprivileged container the whole time.
